data.name: E-Mountain Bike Tours
data.headline: For all ages • 4 hours
data.description:
##Duration
4 hours

##About
Our staff here is made up of talented, passionate riders. Whether you are interested in going on a casual trail ride, challenging yourself on a technical ride, or even interested in where to find some downhill adventure, we are your connection.

Our two go-to destinations are our local Oat Hill Mine Trail, located less than a mile from our shop. With beautiful views and medium technical sections of trail (there are some challenging side features, too), this trail can take you miles above Calistoga into the Palisades that tower above town. This trail is a challenge - it is 4+ miles of climbing right out of the gate, followed by additional rolling terrain if desired, and fun single-track options on the way back down.

Each group we cater to has particular requests and questions - please give us a call to help you set up a unique adventure, whether for a corporate outing or a small group outing.

##Package overview
- Your bike or ours! We rent full-suspension, carbon fiber Santa Cruz and Specialized mountain bikes for our guests to enjoy.
- Trail networks - We are within 40 minutes driving distance of 6 different riding parks in the region which present a broad spectrum of trails.
- Trouble-free - Your guide carries most of the tools needed to make trailside repairs.
- Additional time can be added and is billed by the hour.
data.cancellation_notes:
-  If you cancel up to 5pm 3 calendar days before your reservation date, a refund minus $10 per bike (and booking fee) applies.  For self-guided Cool Wine Tours - once we have booked your itinerary, it is an additional $40 dollar admin fee to cancel, and we will proceed to cancel your tastings before their cancellation policies apply.
 
- If you cancel after 5pm 3 calendars days before your pick up date, but by 5pm the day before you pick up, a refund minus 50% per bike (and booking fee) applies.  For self-guided Cool Wine Tours, please be aware that your wine tastings will likely be non-refundable as well.
 
- If you cancel after 5pm the day prior to your pick up date, all rentals and tours are strictly non-refundable.  The only exception to this is if the hourly rain forecast on your ride day is above 30% between 10am and 5pm.  We recommend keeping an eye on the 5 day forecast for Calistoga and cancel by 5pm 3 days prior if it's looking iffy.  

For cancellations or modifications to your reservation, please call us during work hours (usually 10 to 6) or let us know via email.  
 
- Phone: 707-942-9687
- Email: rentals@calistogabikeshop.com
